backend/main.mo: Main canister actor defining user roles, provider/client profiles, documents, jobs, and platform state with authorization and storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two frontend cleanup tasks tied to LandingPage.tsx edits and associated components/tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of many frontend files describing core pages, components, hooks, styling, and behavior.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base and theme variable definitions for light/dark modes with custom color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML document setting PWA metadata, manifest links, and loading the React app.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: IC domain verification file specifying the app’s canonical domain.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, categories, and display settings.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page shown when network access fails.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker handling install, activate, navigation fallback to offline.html, and static asset caching.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app handling authentication, role onboarding, routing, and service worker registration.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper including header, footer, support drawer, and child content.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Provides a login/logout button using Internet Identity and manages authentication state with loading handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleOnboard: User selects a role (client, provider, back office) and submits it to initialize onboarding.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with copyright text, support trigger, and caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays the main header with logo, navigation based on user role, PWA install button, support trigger, and login control.
frontend/src/components/landing/Platform: Shows animated platform stats for clients and providers with fallback minimums and loading skeleton.
frontend/src/components/landing/Testimon: Displays a grid of predefined client testimonials with ratings and provider avatar details.
frontend/src/components/location/Locatio: Form component for entering or auto-detecting a geographic location, including address and coordinates fields.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Interactive messaging panel allowing clients to send and view messages with a provider, including simulated send and refresh actions.
frontend/src/components/payments/MpesaUn: Dialog handling M-Pesa payment initiation, phone validation, STK push simulation, polling, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/providers/Featur: Avatar component for featured providers with image fallback and initials generation.
Displays a grid of demo featured providers with avatars, ratings, rates, and location info.
frontend/src/components/providers/Provid: Reusable provider avatar with optional profile image and initials fallback in multiple sizes.
Card component showing provider details including rating, verification status, rate, and category.
Dialog presenting a provider preview with avatar, ratings, verification status, availability, and action buttons.
frontend/src/components/providers/Unlock: UI card showing locked provider details, displaying a 10% connection fee and an unlock button with loading state.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallPromp: Banner prompting users to install the PWA, handling iOS instructions, dismissal, and installability checks.
frontend/src/components/ratings/StarRati: Five-star rating input component allowing selection unless in read‑only mode.
frontend/src/components/support/SupportD: Drawer UI providing customer support phone and email contact options with a close action.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and managing a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUpOnVisible.t: Hook that animates a count-up when an element becomes visible using IntersectionObserver and easing.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity authentication, status, login, and stored identity handling.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Hook detecting PWA installability, iOS support, installation events, and exposing a promptInstall function.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user, provider, and search-related data via the backend actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base/theme configuration with light/dark mode variables and custom landing background styles.
frontend/src/lib/categories.ts: Defines service categories with icons and helpers for looking up categories and business type labels.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point configuring React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/Verificati: Backoffice page for reviewing providers, updating verification status, and managing rejection reasons.
frontend/src/pages/client/CategoriesPage: Lists and filters service categories, allowing navigation to results based on selected category.
frontend/src/pages/client/MapViewPage.ts: Displays a map view placeholder or alert when Google Maps is unavailable and lists nearby providers with navigation options.
frontend/src/pages/client/MyJobsPage.tsx: Shows the user's job requests, allows cancellation or completion with rating, and handles related dialogs and mutations.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderDetail: Loads provider details, ratings, verification status, and unlock/payment flow, and allows submitting job requests.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResult: Searches and lists providers by category with preview and navigation to map view or detailed profiles.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page UI with hero section, call‑to‑action, scroll-to sections, and feature components.
frontend/src/pages/provider/ProviderProf: Allows providers to create or edit their profile, upload a picture, set business details, and update location.
frontend/src/pages/provider/Verification: Displays provider verification status and supports uploading academic and conduct documents with progress tracking.
frontend/src/utils/fees.ts: Provides utility functions for computing a 10% connection fee and formatting KES currency values.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL params (including hash routing), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear stored or hash-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, container settings, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Holds project metadata, current app direction, architecture notes, existing features, and known issues for build tracking.
